integrity: Analytic proof and exact-rational finite implementation checks are provided; historical priority and independent proof validation remain outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Only odd simple cycles n>=5, positive uniform screening and a fixed two-class, independently signed, two-solve stochastic trace estimator; no universal estimator optimality. The broad ordering of convex antiferromagnets is previously established; the claimed distinctive result is the exact sharp nonoptimal first variance gap.
title: Sharp second-best two-color trace-probing penalty on odd screened cycles
